snippet.title: Dicefolk - Launch trailer - Android
snippet.description: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure. As a Chimera Summoner, recruit and create your perfect team of mythical beasts and command them to victory using unique dice mechanics. Now on Google Play and Google Play  Pass.
